show.title: The Alpha King’s Redemption
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/qW4VZK
show.description: A humble street-sweeper hiding as “Brij Mohan” is forced to reveal his true identity—the feared Alpha King of the wolf clans—when his teenage daughter is brutalized, kidnapped, and offered as a “gift” to a monstrous trafficker. To save her, he must reclaim his throne, unleash the wolf within, and turn an entire empire of predators into prey.
